title: Septimus site data: one tractate file (site/data/<tractate>.json)
description: Contract between scripts/build_site_data.py (writer) and site/app.js, the feedback worker and the planned sign-up app (readers). Documented in docs/technical/septimus-viewer-plan.md section 3. index.json is validated against #/$defs/index, redirects.json against #/$defs/redirects. A story id is PERMANENT (site/data/story_ids.json, scripts/story_ids.py): minted once, kept across boundary changes; the current source span is the `span` field.

reviewed.description: True when an expert (Jeff) reviewed this tractate's golden.

out_of_scope.description: Retained, never shown by default (biblical, R-S1; Simon 2026-11-13).

slug.description: scripts/tractates.py slug; never a hyphen (ids split on it).

story_id.description: Permanent id from site/data/story_ids.json. Reads as the span it was MINTED with (<tractate>-<daf>-<start>-<end>, -vN if that string was taken), never re-derived: after a boundary change the digits are history. Never parse a span from it; read `span`.

span.description: The story's current SOURCE span, one piece per page (never the display extension). The registry records the same.

i.description: Segment index on that page (Sefaria order).

he.description: Hebrew/Aramaic with nikud; only b/i/strong/em/big/small/br tags.

en.description: William Davidson English; same tag whitelist.

extended.description: null, or a display-only widening (start_back/end_forward) or trim of legal argument (start_trim/end_trim) by whole segments (site/data/boundary_extensions.json).

classification.description: Detector grade. Data only (feedback triage, analysis); the viewer never shows it. LOW_CONFIDENCE only on an `include` decision or a `promote` rule.

summary.description: One reader-facing sentence, or empty (the page then shows none).

included_by.description: Optional. The `promote` rule of results/shas_run/septimus_site_decisions.json that added this story.

redirects.title: site/data/redirects.json
redirects.description: Every id that is no longer active -> the id its story now has (merge), or null (retired). Chains already followed. Derived from story_ids.json; site/app.js reads it to resolve old links and migrate read-checkmarks.

story.description: Number of shipped stories (len of the file's stories).
